column4: Every finitely generated LEF group Gamma embeds in an expander-limit host E = EL_3(R_Delta) whose word problem is Turing equivalent to that of Gamma, for any finite generating families (halfline (a), lem:host, halfline (b), substitution along the embeddings).
A finitely generated group is LEF with solvable word problem iff it is a subgroup of an expander-limit host with solvable word problem; the forward half via the host of the same Turing degree.
For the Delta of halfline (a) and the host G_Delta of lem:host: WP(Delta) is Turing equivalent to WP(Gamma) and WP(G_Delta) to WP(Delta), for any finite generating families.

For every finite generating family t of Delta: G_Delta = EL_3(LampRing Delta) has a finite generating family, and the word problem of every finite family of G_Delta is Turing reducible to wordProblemOracle t (truth-table reduction on the polynomial normal form); hostProof derives solvability.
